objective: Project task-scoped canonical Hawking intelligence into a compact external-worker context without creating a second knowledge store or granting runtime authority.

projection.identity: task, worker, canonical/base revision, source branch, worktree, worker branch
projection.authority: allowed scope/actions, forbidden actions, staging boundary, promotion=false
projection.organ_knowledge: task-term selected compact Organ Passport summaries
projection.gravity_knowledge: bounded method candidates plus controls, Laws, evidence, reopen conditions, and execution frontier
projection.evidence: task-relevant receipt/file handles with SHA-256 where present
projection.stop_conditions: authority, protected-runtime, credential, and scientific-adjudication returns
projection.stale_detection: canonical/base revision and source digests are embedded in every generated packet

claim_boundary: This proves a derived context-view command and focused static/E2E coverage only. It does not qualify Grok Bot, execute a worker, authorize source-teacher admission, qualify a model, establish EBPW/TPS/capability, promote Pulsar, deploy, or retire Kimi.
